verses.text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

segments.text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High
Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

verses.text: I will say of Jehovah, He is my refuge and my fortress; My God, in whom I trust.

segments.text: I will say of Jehovah, He is my refuge and my fortress;
My God, in whom I trust.

verses.text: For he will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, And from the deadly pestilence.

segments.text: For he will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler,
And from the deadly pestilence.

verses.text: He will cover thee with his pinions, And under his wings shalt thou take refuge: His truth is a shield and a buckler.

segments.text: He will cover thee with his pinions,
And under his wings shalt thou take refuge:
His truth is a shield and a buckler.

verses.text: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, Nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

segments.text: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night,
Nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

verses.text: For the pestilence that walketh in darkness, Nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

segments.text: For the pestilence that walketh in darkness,
Nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

verses.text: A thousand shall fall at thy side, And ten thousand at thy right hand; But it shall not come nigh thee.

segments.text: A thousand shall fall at thy side,
And ten thousand at thy right hand;
But
it shall not come nigh thee.

verses.text: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, And see the reward of the wicked.

segments.text: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold,
And see the reward of the wicked.

verses.text: For thou, O Jehovah, art my refuge! Thou hast made the Most High thy habitation;

segments.text: For thou, O Jehovah, art my refuge!
Thou hast made the Most High thy habitation;

verses.text: There shall no evil befall thee, Neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.

segments.text: There shall no evil befall thee,
Neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.

verses.text: For he will give his angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.

segments.text: For he will give his angels charge over thee,
To keep thee in all thy ways.

verses.text: They shall bear thee up in their hands, Lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

segments.text: They shall bear thee up in their hands,
Lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

verses.text: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: The young lion and the serpent shalt thou trample under foot.

segments.text: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder:
The young lion and the serpent shalt thou trample under foot.

verses.text: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

segments.text: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him:
I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

verses.text: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble: I will deliver him, and honor him.

segments.text: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him;
I will be with him in trouble:
I will deliver him, and honor him.

verses.text: With long life will I satisfy him, And show him my salvation.

segments.text: With long life will I satisfy him,
And show him my salvation.
